law_set_summary.system_characterization: convergent evolutionary dynamical system with dominant attractor

laws.name: Attractor Dominance Law
laws.statement: In a constrained evolutionary kernel with stable selection pressure, bounded mutation entropy, a smooth monotonic selection function, and no external diversity perturbation, the system converges to a single dominant attractor basin.
laws.observed_expression: stable_lineage_basin dominates the observed phase space.
testable_predictions: Repeated runs under the same constrained kernel should preserve stable_lineage_basin as the primary basin.
If mutation entropy is increased by a controlled future perturbation, dominance score should decrease or additional basins should appear.
falsification_conditions: A controlled existing-equivalent run shows more than one dominant attractor basin.
stable_lineage_basin loses primary-basin status without external perturbation.
collapse_sink or chaotic basin becomes dominant under unchanged constraints.

laws.name: Regime Non-Transition Law
laws.statement: Regime transitions vanish when fitness variance contracts below the observed stability region and mutation does not introduce directional bias, leaving the system in a self-reinforcing stable-regime loop.
laws.observed_expression: stable_regime->stable_regime is the only observed transition.
testable_predictions: Under the same phase-space constraints, cross-regime transition count should remain zero.
If controlled perturbation raises variance beyond the observed stability region, exploratory or chaotic labels should become observable.
falsification_conditions: An unchanged constrained run records stable_regime->exploratory_regime, exploratory_regime->chaotic_regime, or chaotic_regime->collapse_regime.
Regime transition count becomes nonzero while fitness variance remains in the current convergent range.

laws.name: Lineage Stability Law
laws.statement: Lineage DAGs remain structurally stable when reproduction is constrained by single-loop selection, branching factor is bounded, and cross-lineage recombination is absent.
laws.observed_expression: DAG grows to 808 nodes and 1590 edges without recorded lineage-integrity failure.
testable_predictions: DAG endpoint validity should remain true under unchanged constrained runs.
Branching density should remain finite and positive without topological explosion under unchanged constraints.
falsification_conditions: A lineage edge references a missing parent or child under unchanged constraints.
Branching density grows without bound in a controlled run.
The graph ceases to be a DAG under unchanged single-loop selection.

laws.name: Bounded Diversity Law
laws.statement: Population diversity remains bounded when the fitness function compresses behavioral space, selection pressure favors convergence, and mutation does not explore orthogonal dimensions.
laws.observed_expression: Population remains at configured size across 100 generations while turnover continues inside the stable basin.
testable_predictions: Population count should remain at configured size under unchanged v1.0 constraints.
Turnover may remain nonzero, but collapse and unbounded diversification should remain absent under unchanged constraints.
falsification_conditions: Population count escapes configured bounds under unchanged constraints.
Collapse events occur without external perturbation.
Structural diversification creates additional dominant basins under unchanged constraints.

laws.name: Fitness Convergence Law
laws.statement: Fitness variance decreases over time when selection is deterministic or near-deterministic, environmental signals are static or abstracted, and mutation magnitude is low.
laws.observed_expression: Fitness variance trend is converging, with last-window variance below first-window variance.
testable_predictions: Last-window variance should remain below first-window variance in repeated unchanged runs.
If mutation magnitude is increased by future controlled perturbation, variance ratio should increase.
falsification_conditions: Fitness variance diverges under unchanged constraints.
Last-window variance repeatedly exceeds first-window variance under unchanged constraints.
Fitness convergence disappears while all stated conditions remain unchanged.
